hero_desc: Panel Flow uses artificial intelligence to detect panels, read speech bubbles aloud, translate content, and guide your reading — panel by panel.
feat_subtitle: Smart tools that transform how you read comics and manga on your iPhone and iPad.
f1_desc: Machine learning automatically identifies each panel on the page, with smart ordering for comics and manga.
f2_desc: Detects bubbles, extracts text with OCR, and automatically identifies languages for each page.
f3_desc: Listen to your comics read aloud with Apple TTS or premium OpenAI voices, with synchronized highlighting.
f4_desc: Translate speech bubbles in real time using the iOS Translation framework, with overlay right on the page.
f5_desc: Organize your collection with search, sorting, editable metadata, and a smart "Continue Reading" section.
f6_desc: Manually adjust panels and bubbles, edit OCR text, and refine detection results.
read_desc: Horizontal navigation for comics and manga, or continuous vertical scroll for webtoons. Smooth zoom, adaptive gradient background, and lazy loading for maximum performance.
ai_desc: Guided mode uses machine learning to automatically navigate between panels with zoom and smooth animations. Tap the screen to advance — it's like having a personal guide for each page.
trans_desc: Automatic speech bubble translation right on the page. Detects the original language or lets you choose — read manga and comics without barriers.
guided_desc: See every panel in detail with automatic zoom and animated transitions. The app understands reading direction — left to right for comics, right to left for manga.
fmt_desc: Import comics and manga from any popular format. Panel Flow takes care of the rest.
tech_title: Built with the best of iOS
cta_desc: Available for iPhone and iPad with iOS {min_ios}+. Download free on the App Store.
meta_title: Panel Flow — Smart Comic & Manga Reader
meta_description: Panel Flow: AI-powered comic and manga reader for iOS. Smart panel detection, guided reading, text-to-speech, and translation.
